title.zh: 把格点距离与同色条件写成整数公式
title.en: Express lattice distances and equal colors arithmetically

given.zh: 用两个整数坐标定义三角格点 P(a,b)，并取颜色 (a−2b) mod 7。
given.en: Define triangular lattice points P(a,b) and assign the residue (a−2b) mod 7.

claim.zh: 若 p=a−c、q=b−d，则两格点距离的平方为 (9/16)Q(p,q)；两格点同色当且仅当 7 整除 p−2q。
claim.en: For p=a−c and q=b−d, the squared distance is (9/16)Q(p,q); the colors agree exactly when seven divides p−2q.

statement.en: Put p=a−c and q=b−d. Then P(a,b)−P(c,d)=(3p/4+3q/8, 3√3q/8).

reason.zh: 两个格点的坐标公式逐项相减，把四个整数变量化成一个整数差向量。
reason.en: Subtract the coordinate formulas to reduce four integer variables to one integer difference vector.

reason.zh: 展开平方，q² 的系数为 9/64+27/64=9/16，交叉项为 9pq/16。
reason.en: Expand the squares: the q² coefficient is 9/64+27/64=9/16 and the cross term is 9pq/16.

statement.en: colorOf(a,b)=colorOf(c,d) iff 7 divides (a−2b)−(c−2d), equivalently p−2q.

reason.zh: 颜色是模 7 的剩余类；两个剩余类相等，恰好要求它们的整数差为 7 的倍数。
reason.en: Colors are residue classes modulo seven, whose equality is equivalent to divisibility of the integer difference by seven.

title.zh: 不同同色格点的距离大于 1+2r
title.en: Distinct centers of one color are farther apart than 1+2r

given.zh: 两个格点同色且坐标对不同，所以 (p,q)≠(0,0)，并有 p−2q=7k。
given.en: The points have one color and different coordinate pairs, so (p,q)≠(0,0) and p−2q=7k.

claim.zh: Q(p,q)≥7，因此格点距离的平方至少为 63/16，距离严格大于 1+2r。
claim.en: Q(p,q)≥7, so the squared distance is at least 63/16 and the distance is strictly greater than 1+2r.

statement.en: p−2q=7k implies p=2q+7k and Q(p,q)=7(q²+5qk+7k²).

reason.zh: 把整除条件给出的整数 k 代入 Q=p²+pq+q²，再展开并提出因子 7。
reason.en: Substitute the integer k from divisibility into Q=p²+pq+q², expand, and factor out seven.

statement.zh: 4Q=(2p+q)²+3q²>0；Q 是正整数且为 7 的倍数，所以 Q≥7。
statement.en: 4Q=(2p+q)²+3q²>0. Since Q is a positive integer divisible by seven, Q≥7.

reason.zh: 若右端为零，则 q=0、p=0，与中心坐标对不同矛盾；正的 7 倍数最小为 7。
reason.en: If the right side vanished, both q and p would be zero, contradicting distinct coordinate pairs. The least positive multiple of seven is seven.

reason.zh: 将整数下界送入格点距离公式，乘上正系数 9/16，不等号方向不变。
reason.en: Insert the integer lower bound into the distance formula and multiply by positive 9/16.

reason.zh: r=√3/4 为非负实数，r<1/2 由 3<4 得到；两边距离非负，比较平方即可推出 dist>1+2r。
reason.en: Here r=√3/4≥0, and r<1/2 follows from 3<4. Both distances are nonnegative, so comparison of squares yields dist>1+2r.

title.zh: 在斜坐标的四个整数角中找覆盖格点
title.en: Find a covering center among four integer corners

given.en: For x=(X,Y), invert the lattice coordinates: α=4X/3−4Y/(3√3), β=8Y/(3√3). Their fractional parts p,q lie in [0,1).

claim.zh: 在 (⌊α⌋,⌊β⌋) 的四个相邻整数角中，存在 (m,n) 使 dist(x,P(m,n))≤r。
claim.en: One of the four integer corners adjacent to (⌊α⌋,⌊β⌋) satisfies dist(x,P(m,n))≤r.

reason.zh: 直接代回两个线性式，得到任意平面点的实斜坐标，而不是先假设该点属于格点。
reason.en: Substitution verifies these two linear equations, giving real oblique coordinates for any plane point without assuming it is a lattice point.

statement.en: Let p=α−⌊α⌋ and q=β−⌊β⌋ lie in [0,1). The four corner errors are (p,q), (p−1,q), (p,q−1), (p−1,q−1).

reason.zh: 分别选择每个坐标的下整数或上整数，便把找任意整数中心的问题缩成四个具体候选。
reason.en: Choose either floor or floor plus one in each coordinate, reducing the search for an integer center to four explicit candidates.

statement.zh: Q(u,v)=u²+uv+v²=(u+v/2)²+3v²/4，因此 Q 是凸函数，Q(p−1,q) 也凸。
statement.en: Q(u,v)=u²+uv+v²=(u+v/2)²+3v²/4, so Q is convex, as is Q(p−1,q).

reason.zh: 平方是凸函数，线性式的平方与非负加权和仍凸。多边形内任一点都是顶点的凸组合，所以函数值不超过顶点值的最大值；下面用这个事实读出 1/3 的具体来源。
reason.en: Squares of linear forms and their nonnegative sums are convex. Every point of a polygon is a convex combination of its vertices, so its value is bounded by the largest vertex value. This explains the numerical bound 1/3 below.

statement.en: Region 00 is p,q≥0, 2p+q≤1, p+2q≤1. Its successive vertices are (0,0), (1/2,0), (1/3,1/3), (0,1/2), with Q values 0, 1/4, 1/3, 1/4.

reason.zh: 把相邻边界联立得到四个顶点，再逐一代入 Q。凸性使整个区域都有 Q(p,q)≤1/3；这就是 corner00 使用的不等式。
reason.en: Intersect adjacent boundary lines to find the four vertices and substitute them into Q. Convexity gives Q(p,q)≤1/3 throughout the region, the inequality used in corner00.

statement.en: Choose corner (0,0) in region 00. If 2p+q≥2 and p+2q≥2, choose (1,1), with Q(p−1,q−1)≤1/3.

reason.zh: 第二种情形令 u=1−p、v=1−q，则 u,v≥0、2u+v≤1、u+2v≤1，落入 00 区域。又 Q(p−1,q−1)=Q(u,v)，所以 corner11 由同一个 1/3 上界得到。
reason.en: In the second case set u=1−p, v=1−q. Then u,v≥0, 2u+v≤1 and u+2v≤1, putting them in region 00. Since Q(p−1,q−1)=Q(u,v), the same bound proves corner11.

statement.en: Outside regions 00 and 11, q≤p gives 1≤2p+q and p+2q≤2, selecting (1,0); when p≤q select (0,1).

reason.zh: q≤p 使 2p+q≥p+2q：排除 00 迫使较大者大于 1，排除 11 迫使较小者小于 2。交换 p、q 得到另一支；全序比较保证剩下的点都进入其中一支。
reason.en: When q≤p, 2p+q≥p+2q. Excluding 00 forces the larger expression above one, and excluding 11 forces the smaller below two. Swap p and q for the other branch; their total order covers every remaining point.

reason.zh: 这五条线性界恰是 corner10 的假设；相邻边界相交得到所列五边形。它包含前一行 q≤p 分支的全部点，因此还需在这个区域上估计对应误差。
reason.en: These five linear bounds are precisely the assumptions of corner10. Adjacent boundary intersections give the listed pentagon, containing the entire q≤p branch from the preceding line.

statement.en: At these five vertices, Q(p−1,q) has values 1/4, 0, 1/4, 1/3, 1/3. Thus Q(p−1,q)≤1/3 throughout region 10.

reason.zh: 逐点代入平移后的二次型，再用其凸性将顶点界传到整个五边形。这给出了选择右下角 (1,0) 时的覆盖估计。
reason.en: Evaluate the translated quadratic form at each vertex and use convexity to extend their bound to the whole pentagon. This gives the covering estimate for corner (1,0).

statement.zh: 01 分支交换 p、q 后落入 10 区域，且 Q(p,q−1)=Q(q−1,p)≤1/3。
statement.en: Swapping p and q maps branch 01 into region 10, and Q(p,q−1)=Q(q−1,p)≤1/3.

reason.zh: Q 对两个变量对称；交换后的五条假设就是 corner01 调用 corner10 时的条件。因此左上角 (0,1) 也已覆盖，并与 00、11、10 一起穷尽整个方格。
reason.en: The form Q is symmetric in its two variables. The swapped five hypotheses are exactly those used when corner01 invokes corner10. This covers corner (0,1) and, together with 00, 11 and 10, exhausts the square.

statement.en: For the selected integer corner (m,n), dist(x,P(m,n))²=(9/16)Q(α−m,β−n)≤3/16=r².

reason.zh: 使用实斜坐标的距离公式与已选角的 Q 界，再由距离和 r 均非负取平方根，得到 dist≤r。
reason.en: Use the distance formula in real oblique coordinates and the chosen corner bound. Since distance and r are nonnegative, take square roots to obtain dist≤r.

title.zh: 定义全平面着色并保留覆盖证据
title.en: Define the plane coloring together with its covering bound

given.zh: covering 已为每个点 x 提供整数 a,b，满足 dist(x,P(a,b))≤r。
given.en: covering supplies integers a,b with dist(x,P(a,b))≤r for every x.

claim.zh: triColor(x) 取所选格点的颜色。每个 x 都同时具有距中心不超过 r、颜色等于中心颜色这两条性质；并且 r<1/2。
claim.en: triColor(x) is its chosen center’s color. Every point is within r of a center of its color, and r<1/2.

statement.zh: 为每个 x 固定覆盖见证 aₓ,bₓ，记 Cₓ=P(aₓ,bₓ)；则 dist(x,Cₓ)≤r。
statement.en: For each x fix covering witnesses aₓ,bₓ and put Cₓ=P(aₓ,bₓ), with dist(x,Cₓ)≤r.

reason.zh: Classical.choose 选取整数见证，choose_spec 同时保留距离界；定义着色后仍能取回这条证据。
reason.en: Classical.choose selects the integer witnesses, while choose_spec retains the distance bound so it remains available after defining the coloring.

statement.en: triColor(x)=colorOf(aₓ,bₓ)∈Fin 7.

reason.zh: 颜色直接取所选中心的模 7 颜色；因此每个点都能拿出一个与自己同色、距离不超过 r 的中心。
reason.en: Assign the modulo-seven color of the chosen center. Every point thus has a center of the same color within distance r.

reason.zh: 这个严格不等式将用于排除同一中心覆盖两个单位距离点；它与前面较大的同色中心间隔分别控制两种情况。
reason.en: This strict inequality excludes two unit-distance points sharing a center. Together with the larger equal-color center separation, it controls the two cases separately.

title.zh: 同一个覆盖格点容不下单位距离的两点
title.en: A shared covering center excludes distance one

given.zh: 设 dist(x,y)=1、triColor(x)=triColor(y)，其所选中心分别为 P(a,b)、P(c,d)。
given.en: Assume dist(x,y)=1 and triColor(x)=triColor(y), with chosen centers P(a,b), P(c,d).

claim.zh: 若 (a,b)=(c,d)，就推出 dist(x,y)<1，与题设矛盾。
claim.en: If (a,b)=(c,d), then dist(x,y)<1, contradicting the hypothesis.

statement.zh: 若 Cₓ=Cᵧ=C，则 dist(x,C)≤r 且 dist(C,y)=dist(y,C)≤r。
statement.en: If Cₓ=Cᵧ=C, then dist(x,C)≤r and dist(C,y)=dist(y,C)≤r.

reason.zh: 把同一个中心代入两份覆盖证据，并用距离对称性使两条路段首尾相接。
reason.en: Use the shared center in both covering bounds and symmetry of distance to join the two segments.

statement.en: 1=dist(x,y)≤dist(x,C)+dist(C,y)≤2r<1, a contradiction.

reason.zh: 三角不等式将单位距离压到严格小于一，故两个所选中心的整数坐标对不能相同。
reason.en: The triangle inequality makes the unit distance strictly less than one, so the integer coordinate pairs of the chosen centers cannot agree.

title.zh: 不同同色中心也与单位距离矛盾
title.en: Distinct equal-color centers give the final contradiction

given.zh: 两个中心不同；triColor 的相等和中心颜色等式给出 colorOf(a,b)=colorOf(c,d)。
given.en: The centers differ. Equality of triColor and the center-color identities imply colorOf(a,b)=colorOf(c,d).

claim.zh: 单位距离的点必异色，因此 triColor 见证 ProperColoring 7。
claim.en: Points at distance one have different colors, so triColor witnesses ProperColoring 7.

statement.en: If triColor(x)=triColor(y), then colorOf(aₓ,bₓ)=colorOf(aᵧ,bᵧ).

reason.zh: 分别展开两点颜色等于所选中心颜色的定义，使平面点的同色假设变成格点的同色条件。
reason.en: Expand each point’s color as its chosen center’s color, converting the plane-color assumption into equality of lattice colors.

statement.zh: 中心坐标对不同时，dist(Cₓ,Cᵧ)>1+2r；但 dist(Cₓ,Cᵧ)≤dist(Cₓ,x)+1+dist(y,Cᵧ)≤1+2r。
statement.en: For distinct center pairs, dist(Cₓ,Cᵧ)>1+2r, but dist(Cₓ,Cᵧ)≤dist(Cₓ,x)+1+dist(y,Cᵧ)≤1+2r.

reason.zh: 严格下界来自同色格点分离；上界沿 Cₓ→x→y→Cᵧ 使用两次三角不等式和两份覆盖界。
reason.en: The strict lower bound comes from equal-color lattice separation. The upper bound follows along Cₓ→x→y→Cᵧ from two triangle inequalities and the covering bounds.

statement.zh: 中心相同与不同两支都矛盾，故 dist(x,y)=1 ⇒ triColor(x)≠triColor(y)；取这个 triColor 作为七色着色。
statement.en: Both center cases contradict equal colors, so dist(x,y)=1 implies triColor(x)≠triColor(y). Use triColor as the seven-color witness.

reason.zh: 前一步排除了相同坐标对，本步排除了不同坐标对，穷尽所有可能，正好得到 ProperColoring 7 的要求。
reason.en: The previous step excluded equal coordinate pairs and this step excludes unequal pairs, exhausting the possibilities and establishing ProperColoring 7.
